_README: Extractions (Bolna 'dispositions') created on each agent by app/bolna_setup.py; edit here and re-run scripts/start.py, changed questions are replaced. The code reads each answer by its exact name (services.extraction_value). Keep answers to one word or one number where possible: Bolna's extractor sometimes answers in a sentence even when asked for JSON, and services.yes_no/number read those leniently.

questions.quotes_json: From this call, list every item the supplier quoted a price for. Return ONLY a JSON array, no other text. Each element: {"item": "<English item name, lowercase>", "unit_price": "<the price number as said, e.g. 25>", "unit": "<kg, quintal or litre>", "available": <true or false>, "delivery_time": "<HH:MM or the supplier's words, e.g. shaam tak>", "credit_days": <number, 0 if none>, "delivery_fee": <number, 0 if none>, "what_they_said": "<the supplier's own words about this price>"}. Use the FINAL price the supplier agreed to. If no price was given, return [].
questions.do_not_call: Did the person ask not to be called again? Answer exactly yes or no.
questions.approval: Did the owner clearly approve booking this order? Answer with one word: yes, no or unclear.
questions.order_json: Return ONLY JSON: {"items": [{"name": "<English item, lowercase>", "quantity": <number>, "unit": "kg or litre or piece"}], "deadline": "<HH:MM 24h>", "budget": <rupees or null>}
questions.confirmed: Did the supplier clearly say yes to supplying this order at the quantities and prices the agent read out? Answer with one word: yes or no.
questions.confirm_changed: Did the supplier change, dispute or refuse any quantity, price or delivery time during the call? Answer with one word: yes or no.
questions.confirm_total: What total amount in rupees did the supplier agree to? Answer with only the number, for example 900. If no total was agreed, answer 0.
questions.confirm_delivery_time: By what time did the supplier say they will deliver to the buyer? Answer briefly as HH:MM (for example 07:00) or in the supplier's words. If not said, answer none.
